items.title: Macaulay Culkin to Star in 'Home Alone' Sequel Written by Seth Rogen: Details
items.summary:
Macaulay Culkin might find himself home alone once again.

Multiple outlets reported on Friday, November 20, that Culkin, 46, is in talks to return to the Home Alone franchise in a sequel developed by Disney and 20th Century Studios. Seth Rogen and his producing and writing partner, Evan Goldberg , are reportedly attached to pen the script, which is based on an idea that Culkin himself pitched to Disney in recent months.

The plot centers on Culkin’s character, Kevin McCallister, as a father, according to Deadline .

Us reached out to reps for Disney for comment.

In July, Culkin was reportedly spotted at Walt Disney Studios in Burbank, California, to discuss the potential film.

“I got a tip the other day that there was a very interesting sighting on the Disney lot: Macaulay Culkin was there,” veteran entertainment journalist Matthew Belloni shared on his “The Town” podcast. “He’s talked about having an idea for a new Home Alone , and Disney is, like, salivating.”

How to Watch the Christmas Movie Classic 'Home Alone' This Holiday Season 

He continued, “They’re offering him another movie — like, he could do his own passion project if he could also do another Home Alone — and they have a good idea. I’ve talked to people who have heard it, and it’s a really good idea for a Home Alone reboot with Macaulay Culkin.”

As a child, Culkin starred in the original 1990 comedy directed by Chris Columbus . The classic holiday movie follows 8-year-old Kevin, who is accidentally left alone at his parents’ home in Chicago while his family heads off on a Christmas vacation in Paris.…

items.title: 'Alpha Sadist' Convicted of Murdering Woman, 32, He Met in Fetish Chatroom
items.summary:
A self-declared “alpha sadist” in Florida was found guilty of killing and kidnapping a British piano tutor after they connected on a fetish chatroom and allegedly arranged for him to kill her.

Dwain Hall was convicted on Friday, November 20, in the death of Sonia Exelby  in October 2025, according to the Daily Mail .

A jury of 12 people deliberated for about an hour before they told Judge Timothy McCourt that they had reached a unanimous verdict. During the deliberation, the jury concluded that the murder was premeditated.

Hall, 53, immediately learned his fate and was given two consecutive life sentences in prison.

Man Accused of Stabbing Girlfriend and Her Child Is Sentenced to Death 

Just days before her murder, Exelby, 32, flew from the United Kingdom to Florida to meet up with Hall.

Authorities in the U.K. considered her to be endangered and missing when she didn’t make her return flight to England on October 13, 2025. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement eventually got involved in the case, and authorities found evidence on Exelby’s computer that indicated “she was suicidal and traveling to the United States to be possibly sexually abused, tortured, and murdered,” according to Hall’s arrest affidavit obtained by Us .

Florida investigators learned that Hall picked Exelby up from the airport on October 10, 2025, and they traveled to an Airbnb in Reddick, Florida.

Amid the investigation, Hall told police that Exelby promised to pay him $4,000 to kill her. He also explained that they had known each other for two years after they connected in online chat…

items.title: Jax Taylor Shares Positive Update After Surgery to Remove Cancerous Tumor
items.summary:
Jax Taylor is staying positive as he awaits the results of his surgery to remove a cancerous tumor.

“This is my incredible surgeon, @heydoctormike, who performed my surgery,” the Valley alum, 47, wrote via Instagram on Friday, November 20, alongside a photo with his surgeon. “He’s taken the time to explain everything to me every step of the way and I can’t thank him and his entire team enough.”

Taylor continued, “For those asking, I underwent a robotic-assisted left partial nephrectomy to remove a 4.1 cm cancerous tumor from my left kidney, classified as clinical Stage I (T1b) kidney cancer.”

The reality star added that he is now waiting to receive “the final pathology results,” which are expected in about a week.

“These results will confirm the exact type and characteristics of the tumor, its final stage and whether the surgical margins are clear, which will help us know if all the cancer was successfully removed,” he continued.

Jax Taylor's Cancer Diagnosis After Discovering Tumor and More Top Us Stories 

Taylor ended his update on a positive note, sharing footage of a rainbow on his way home.

“As I was driving home from the hospital, I saw one of the biggest rainbows I’ve ever seen. It gave me chills,” he wrote. “After everything, it felt like a sign of a fresh start and better days ahead 🌈.”

Taylor concluded, “Thank you to everyone who has reached out with prayers and support. It means more than you know🙏❤️.”

items.summary:
Nick Cannon appears to have suffered a health setback amid his lupus battle.

“This 🌍can definitely take a lot out of you,” Cannon, 46, wrote via Instagram on Friday, November 20. “Pray for me y’all.”

In his social media post, the Masked Singer host shared a selfie from a hospital room, wearing a mask and wrapped in blankets.

“🙏🏾❤️ #LupusWarrior,” he captioned the post as Donny Hathaway ’s “A Song for You” played in the background.

Nick Cannon Says He Wouldn't Be Alive With 'Rock' Mariah Carey   

Cannon first shared his Lupus diagnosis in 2012. According to the Mayo Clinic , the condition occurs when the body’s immune system attacks its own tissues and organs.

Nick Cannon Frazer Harrison/Getty Images 
 Lupus can cause swelling and irritation, called inflammation, that may affect joints, skin, kidneys, blood cells, brain, heart and lungs.

Jeffrey Roberson was sentenced on Monday, November 16, to 26 years to life in prison in the 2008 killing of Cecil Zachary Jr. at Zachary’s Oceanside home, according to the San Diego County District Attorney’s Office .

“This was a brutal and intentional killing of a vulnerable victim in his own home,” San Diego County District Attorney Summer Stephan said in a news release. “For more than 18 years, Cecil’s loved ones endured the pain and unanswered questions surrounding his death.”

A jury found Roberson, 60, guilty of first-degree murder on August 27 following a six-day trial, with the special allegation that he used a wooden log to kill Zachary, who was 51 when he died, according to prosecutors.

Suspected Killer Arrested in 1994 Cold Case Stabbing of Man in San Diego 

A home care nurse found Zachary dead in his hospital bed, with a towel covering his face, in his living room on June 19, 2008, prosecutors said.

Officers called to Zachary’s house located a wooden log inside the residence, believing it was used as the murder weapon.

Zachary was paralyzed below his waist after he was injured in a car crash several years prior to his death, and often remained in his hospital bed, prosecutors said.

His cause of death was “blunt-force injuries to the head,” the county’s medical examiner determined, according to the district attorney’s office.
